Boy holds the yogurt bowl poised to set down near toast, girl points gently toward fruit. Open clear tabletop areas around all props, foods not piled up, a simple glass of water at far edge. Top quarter mostly calm mint wall for later editorial caption. Image visually communicates adding variety to an existing breakfast. No magical energy beams or predicted blood-sugar reactions.
